ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

clock_waveform.output_TMDS_clock_freq_MHz: 25 to 165 (= IDCK; TXC is a 1:1 buffered + level-shifted differential copy of IDCK, not 10× the bit clock)
clock_waveform.leading_edge: EDGE bit / pin selects: EDGE=1 → rising edge of IDCK+; EDGE=0 → falling edge of IDCK+.
clock_waveform.trailing_edge: Opposite of leading edge; not used for latching in single-edge mode.
clock_waveform.differential_clock_crossover: In differential mode, the IDCK+ ↔ IDCK- crossover point is the timing reference; differential mode is only available in low-swing mode (V_REF ≤ 0.9 V).
clock_waveform.single_edge_mode: 24-bit DATA latched on the EDGE-selected edge of IDCK+.
clock_waveform.dual_edge_mode: 12-bit DATA[11:0] latched on BOTH edges of IDCK+; first latch edge selected by EDGE; LSB-half and MSB-half multiplexed per Tables 6-2 / 6-3.

output_tmds_waveform.step_1_power_up: PD=1 (via pin or register) → PLL begins locking (few µs).
output_tmds_waveform.step_2_pll_lock: 10× PLL locks to IDCK; serializer bit clock = 10 × IDCK frequency.
output_tmds_waveform.step_3_encode_pixel: Each IDCK period: encode 3 × 8-bit pixels (R, G, B) → 3 × 10-bit TMDS characters.
output_tmds_waveform.step_4_serialize: Each 10-bit symbol shifted out per channel at bit rate = 10 × IDCK (LSB-first on the wire).
output_tmds_waveform.step_5_differential_swing: Each TX+ / TX- pair drives 400-600 mV single-ended (V_SWING), set by R_TFADJ.
output_tmds_waveform.step_6_de_low_blanking: When DE=low, encoder emits control characters: TX0 = {VSYNC,HSYNC} code, TX1 = {CTL[1],0} code, TX2 = {CTL[3],CTL[2]} code with CTL[3]=0.
output_tmds_waveform.step_7_de_high_active: When DE=high, encoder emits transition-minimised + DC-balanced video characters per channel.
output_tmds_waveform.step_8_disable: PD=0 or TDIS=1 gates driver to V_OFF (both TX+ and TX- pulled to AV_DD).

single_edge_falling_idr.description: Setup / hold of DATA, DE, VSYNC, HSYNC to IDCK+ falling edge (BSEL=1, DSEL=0, DKEN=0, EDGE=0).

single_edge_rising_idr.description: Setup / hold of DATA, DE, VSYNC, HSYNC to IDCK+ rising edge (BSEL=1, DSEL=0, DKEN=0, EDGE=1).

dual_edge_id.description: Setup / hold of DATA, DE, VSYNC, HSYNC to BOTH IDCK+ edges in 12-bit dual-edge mode (BSEL=0, DSEL=1, DKEN=0).

deskew_waveform.formula: t_CD = (DK[3:1] - 4) × t_STEP, where t_STEP ≈ 350 ps; data can be latched 4·t_STEP early to 3·t_STEP late relative to IDCK edge.
deskew_waveform.purpose: Compensate IDCK ↔ DATA arrival skew at the TFP410 input; clock itself is NOT delayed, only the data latching window.

i2c_waveform.format: Standard I2C (Philips/NXP I2C-bus specification). 7-bit address + R/W bit + ACK; 8-bit data + ACK per byte.
i2c_waveform.SCL_clock_freq_kHz: Standard 100 kHz; Fast 400 kHz (TFP410 supports both implicitly; not separately specified in datasheet).
i2c_waveform.start_condition: SDA HIGH-to-LOW transition while SCL HIGH.
i2c_waveform.stop_condition: SDA LOW-to-HIGH transition while SCL HIGH.
i2c_waveform.data_transition: SDA changes only while SCL LOW; data sampled on SCL HIGH.
i2c_waveform.ack_at_9th_clock: Receiver pulls SDA LOW during 9th SCL clock; NAK = SDA HIGH at 9th clock.

tmds_character_serialization.format: Per-channel: 10 bits per IDCK period; LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 9 last).
tmds_character_serialization.channel_independence: Each channel (TX0/TX1/TX2) has its own encoder + running-disparity state; channels do NOT share state.
tmds_character_serialization.control_vs_video: DE=low → control character; DE=high → video character. Each is a 10-bit code emitted in 1 IDCK period.

general_timing_rule: All TMDS output bit times are derived from the recovered bit clock = 10 × f_IDCK. Per channel, 10 bits are emitted in each IDCK period. IDCK ↔ DATA setup/hold must be met at the input. PLL multiplies IDCK by 10× to generate the bit clock; on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass caps reduce PLL noise; output jitter t_ojit ≤ 150 ps relative to IDCK.
